title: Higher direct images of affine morphisms
statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ be an affine morphism and $\mathcal{F}$ a quasi-coherent
$\mathcal{O}_X$-module. Then $R^if_*\mathcal{F}=0$ for all $i>0$, and $f_*\mathcal{F}$ is
quasi-coherent.

proof.text: For every point $y\in S$, the stalk of $R^if_*\mathcal F$ is the filtered colimit of $H^i(f^{-1}(V),\mathcal F|_{f^{-1}(V)})$ over open neighborhoods $V$ of $y$ [lem-weil-pbc-higher-direct-image-presheaf]. Affine opens containing $y$ are cofinal among these neighborhoods, and for such an affine $V$ the inverse image $f^{-1}(V)$ is affine by the definition of an affine morphism [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. The restriction of $\mathcal F$ remains quasi-coherent, so [lem-pc-affine-vanishing] makes each term of this cofinal colimit zero when $i>0$. Hence every stalk of $R^if_*\mathcal F$ is zero, and [pqf-lem-sheaf-zero-stalks] gives $R^if_*\mathcal F=0$.

source.place: Lemma 01E4 (description of higher direct images) together with Schemes, Lemma 01EO (affine cohomology vanishing)

proof.text: An affine morphism is quasi-compact and quasi-separated by clause (3) of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-permanence]. Therefore [pqf-lem-pushforward-qcoh] applies directly and gives that $f_*\mathcal F$ is quasi-coherent.
